narrative.overview: The selected Option 2 cream/sage/Bitter/Manrope world now has a full editorial homepage, following the user’s explicit correction of the compact web-app-like composition. Visitors read the hospital story, both care chapters with all eight services, five clinicians, education, research and visit guidance before following dedicated routes. Search, checklist and detail pages remain; the care explorer is dormant. This remains a local preview before production.
keyCharacteristics: Cream and sage palette with flat tonal hierarchy
Persistent header, real route breadcrumbs and contextual next steps
Reduced-motion static journey; no raster or stock imagery
Keyboard page search, sticky navigation and reading orientation
Local preparation checklist on Visit; Lottie on Home only
Full editorial homepage with eight visible service summaries and five clinician links
Equal general and Unani chapters; desktop sticky introductions and mobile static flow
Mirrored Unani desktop chapter; heading-first mobile flow
Centered five-clinician gallery, three-plus-two desktop layout and licensed React Bits spotlight adaptation

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Compare composition within the confirmed cream and pastel-green commitment.

rules.name: The Chapter Continuity Rule
rules.body: Animate the chapter inside the persistent shell; use real parent routes for breadcrumbs.

dos: Do preserve equal prominence for general hospital and Unani care.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and the local-preview boundary.
Do use the existing default/outline Button variants through Action links.
Do keep source workbook, reports and review controls local.
Do show completed journey frame 90 when motion is off or reduced.
Do preserve usable search, selection, checkboxes and disclosure with motion disabled.
Do keep native checkbox targets above decorative boxes and scroll margins around focused controls.
Do follow research/home-story-brief.md as current homepage authority.
Do communicate each section’s key information before linking to the detailed page.
Do retain React Bits attribution/license with DoctorSpotlight; initials are not clinician portraits.
Do provide flat keyboard/touch-compatible states and remove positional feedback with motion disabled.
donts: Don't confuse design and display-name selection with approval of clinical claims, legal identity or production launch.
Don't fabricate hospital assets, credentials or clinical outcomes.
Don't treat the leaf mark or geometric SVG favicon as the official logo.
Don't present the care explorer as symptom triage or treatment recommendation.
Do not restore the dormant care explorer as the homepage composition; the user rejected that app-like presentation.
